Adds beta Admin API route GET /v1/organizations/api_keys/{api_key_id}?beta=true to retrieve API key details (BetaApiKey) by ID. Requires Admin x-api-key; returns 200 on success or 4XX BetaErrorResponse.

Beta POST endpoint to update an organization API key by ID (?beta=true). Body: BetaApiKeyUpdateParams (name and/or status). Returns updated BetaApiKey; 4XX returns BetaErrorResponse. Supports optional anthropic-version header.

Adds beta endpoint GET /v1/organizations/api_keys?beta=true to list organization API keys with cursor pagination (before_id, after_id, limit) and filters (status, workspace_id, created_by_user_id). Returns ApiKey objects with metadata (id, name, status, scope, principal, created_at, expires_at, partial_key_hint). Requires Admin API key (x-api-key) and anthropic-version headers.

Introduces beta GET /v1/organizations/cost_report (use beta=true) to retrieve organization cost reports as 1d time buckets. Supports required starting_at, optional ending_at, pagination via limit/page, and grouping by description or workspace_id. Returns USD amounts with cost metadata (model, token_type, service_tier, inference_geo, etc.).

New beta endpoint to validate an external key by running an encrypt/decrypt roundtrip against the customer's KMS (waits up to 30s). Returns 200 with status=success or failure and an error message if it fails.

Introduces DELETE /v1/organizations/external_keys/{external_key_id}?beta=true to delete an external key config by ID; request is rejected if any workspace still references it. Returns the deleted key ID and type.
Adds beta endpoint to retrieve a single CMEK external key config by ID within the caller's organization.

Adds a beta POST endpoint to partially update an external key config by ID. You can always edit display_name; geo and provider_config are only editable before any workspace attaches. Path param: external_key_id. Optional anthropic-version header. Returns the updated ExternalKey on success.
Adds beta GET /v1/organizations/external_keys to list CMEK external key configs in the caller's org, ordered newest-first with cursor-based pagination (limit, page). Requires beta=true.
Creates a CMEK external key configuration for the caller's organization (AWS, GCP, or Azure KMS) and returns the created config.

Adds POST /v1/organizations/federation_issuers/{federation_issuer_id}/archive?beta=true to archive a federation issuer. Idempotent; 400 if any live federation rule references the issuer. Requires OAuth access token with org:admin scope.
Added beta GET /v1/organizations/federation_issuers/{federation_issuer_id}?beta=true to retrieve a federation issuer by ID. Requires OAuth token with org:admin scope; Admin API keys not accepted.

Adds beta POST /v1/organizations/federation_issuers/{federation_issuer_id}?beta=true to partially update a federation issuer. Requires OAuth access token with org:admin scope (Admin API keys not accepted). Archived issuers cannot be updated; setting jwks replaces the entire JWKS config. Some updates require a Console session if the issuer backs rules with scopes beyond workspace:developer or workspace:inference.

Introduces beta GET /v1/organizations/federation_issuers to list an org’s federation issuers with pagination. Archived issuers are excluded by default (use include_archived=true). Requires OAuth access token with org:admin scope; Admin API keys not accepted.

Adds a beta endpoint to register an external OIDC issuer for workload identity federation (requires OAuth org:admin). Supports JWKS via discovery, explicit URL, or inline keys, plus options like check_jti and max_jwt_lifetime_seconds.

Adds a beta endpoint to archive a federation rule, immediately stopping token exchange. Idempotent (re-archiving returns the same archived_at) and clears workspace targeting (workspace_id/workspace_ids emptied). Tokens minted before archiving remain valid until expiry. Requires an OAuth access token with org:admin (Admin API keys not accepted). Enable via ?beta=true.

Adds a beta DELETE endpoint to disable a federation rule for a workspace. Idempotent; requires OAuth access token with org:admin scope (Admin API keys not accepted). OAuth callers may only manage rules with oauth_scope workspace:developer or workspace:inference.

Added beta endpoint GET /v1/organizations/federation_rules/{federation_rule_id}/workspaces?beta=true to list workspaces where a federation rule is enabled. Requires OAuth token with org:admin (Admin API keys not accepted). Returns explicit per-workspace enablements; limit/page accepted but ignored, next_page always null.

New beta endpoint to enable a federation rule for a workspace. Requires OAuth token with org:admin; idempotent; archived rules rejected; OAuth callers limited to rules with oauth_scope workspace:developer or workspace:inference.
Adds a beta GET endpoint to retrieve a federation rule by ID (fdrl_...), requiring an OAuth access token with org:admin; returns BetaFederationRule on success or BetaErrorResponse on error.

Beta endpoint to partially update a federation rule by ID. Requires OAuth org:admin token (no Admin API keys). issuer_id is immutable; match/target are replaced as whole objects; null clears description/attributes. Archived rules cannot be updated. Well-known issuers must constrain tenant identity; OAuth callers are limited to oauth_scope workspace:developer or workspace:inference. Returns the updated federation rule or 4XX on errors (e.g., invalid references).

Added beta GET /v1/organizations/federation_rules to list organization federation rules with pagination, optional issuer_id filter, and include_archived; requires OAuth token with org:admin scope (Admin API keys not accepted).

Introduces POST /v1/organizations/federation_rules?beta=true to create an organization-owned federation rule. Requires OAuth access token with org:admin (Admin API keys not accepted). Validates issuer and target service account existence; supports enabling per workspace or all workspaces; enforces tenant constraints for well-known issuers; OAuth callers may only set oauth_scope to workspace:developer or workspace:inference. Returns the created federation rule.

Introduces a beta DELETE endpoint at /v1/organizations/invites/{invite_id}?beta=true to remove a pending organization invite by ID. Returns an object with type "invite_deleted" and the invite id on success.

Adds a beta GET endpoint to retrieve an organization invite by ID. Returns invite details (email, role, status, timestamps, RBAC groups) as BetaInviteSchema on 200; errors use BetaErrorResponse. Requires path param invite_id; supports x-api-key and anthropic-version headers.

Introduces beta route GET /v1/organizations/invites to list organization invites with pagination (limit, before_id, after_id) and filters (statuses[], roles[], email). Returns a ListResponse of invite objects; 4XX uses BetaErrorResponse. Auth via Admin API key header.

Introduces a beta endpoint to invite a user to an organization by email. On seat-limited plans, the invite automatically consumes the lowest-tier available seat and fails with 400 if none are free. Supports role assignment (no admin via API; Enterprise: user/managed) and optional rbac_group_ids for Enterprise with write:rbac_groups scope. Returns invite details on success; standard 4XX error types on failure. Optional anthropic-version header.

Adds beta GET /v1/organizations/me?beta=true to retrieve the authenticated key’s organization (id, name, type). Returns 200 BetaOrganizationSchema or 4XX BetaErrorResponse; supports x-api-key and anthropic-version headers.

Introduces beta GET /v1/organizations/rate_limits to list an organization’s rate limits by group (model families and API categories). Supports optional filters (model, group_type), returns per-group limiters with next_page for future pagination; 404 if model filter not found; uses Admin API key and anthropic-version headers.

Adds POST /v1/organizations/service_accounts/{service_account_id}/archive?beta=true to archive a service account. Idempotent; returns the original archived_at if already archived. Requires OAuth token with org:admin scope (WIF ok); Admin API keys not accepted. Returns BetaServiceAccount on success. 400 if any live federation rule still targets the service account.

New beta endpoint to remove a service account from a workspace. Requires OAuth token with org:admin scope; operation is idempotent; deleting implicit default-workspace membership is a no-op; archived workspaces return 400.

New beta GET /v1/organizations/service_accounts/{service_account_id}/workspaces lists all workspaces a service account belongs to, including workspace_role. Supports limit and next_page pagination and returns an implicit default-workspace membership first when no explicit default exists. Requires OAuth access token with org:admin (Admin API keys not accepted). Memberships are returned only while the service account is active.

Adds POST /v1/organizations/service_accounts/{service_account_id}/workspaces?beta=true to create or update a service account’s explicit membership in a workspace by assigning workspace_role. Requires OAuth access token with org:admin scope (Admin API keys not accepted). Rejects archived workspaces and archived service accounts. Mirrors POST /workspaces/{workspace_id}/service_accounts. Request body: {workspace_id, workspace_role}. Returns service_account_workspace_member.

New beta endpoint GET /v1/organizations/service_accounts/{service_account_id}?beta=true to retrieve a service account by ID. Requires OAuth token with org:admin scope (Admin API keys not accepted). Returns BetaServiceAccount on success or BetaErrorResponse on error.

Adds POST /v1/organizations/service_accounts/{service_account_id}?beta=true to update a service account's description or organization_role. Requires OAuth org:admin scope; archived accounts cannot be updated; promoting to admin requires an interactive credential.

Introduces a beta endpoint GET /v1/organizations/service_accounts?beta=true to list service accounts in the caller's organization, ordered by creation time; supports pagination (limit, next_page) and include_archived; requires an OAuth access token with org:admin scope.

Adds beta endpoint POST /v1/organizations/service_accounts?beta=true to create a service account in the caller's org. Requires OAuth token with org:admin scope (no Admin API keys). Body: name (required), optional description, organization_role (developer default or admin). Returns the created service account.

Deprecated Admin API endpoint to archive a tunnel. Archival is irreversible; all active certificates are archived, the hostname is permanently retired, and the tunnel token is invalidated. Safe to retry on already-archived tunnels (idempotent). Superseded by /v1/tunnels with anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22 and a WIF token scoped to workspace:manage_tunnels.

Adds a deprecated Admin API endpoint to archive a tunnel certificate for a given tunnel, removing it from the tunnel’s trusted set. Returns the certificate object; archiving the last active cert causes the tunnel to reject MCP traffic until a new cert is added. Superseded by /v1/tunnels (use anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22).

New deprecated Admin API route to retrieve a single tunnel certificate by ID: GET /v1/organizations/tunnels/{tunnel_id}/certificates/{certificate_id}?beta=true. Superseded by /v1/tunnels on the Claude API; new integrations should use anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22 with a WIF token (workspace:manage_tunnels). Existing integrations may continue with mcp-tunnels-2026-05-19 and org:manage_tunnels during the migration window.

Deprecated Admin API endpoint to list certificates registered on a tunnel. Archived certs excluded by default (use include_archived=true to include). Not paginated (tunnels have at most two active certs). Superseded by /v1/tunnels with anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22 and WIF scope workspace:manage_tunnels.

Deprecated Admin API endpoint to register a public CA certificate for a tunnel. Anthropic verifies the inner TLS session against this CA. Accepts a single PEM-encoded X.509 certificate (no private key); a tunnel may hold at most two non-archived certificates. Superseded by /v1/tunnels on the Claude API with anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22; existing integrations may use mcp-tunnels-2026-05-19 during migration. Returns the registered certificate on 201; 4XX returns an error object.

Added deprecated Admin API endpoint POST /v1/organizations/tunnels/{tunnel_id}/reveal_token?beta=true to reveal a tunnel's current connection token (fetched live; stable until rotation). Superseded by /v1/tunnels with anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22 and a WIF token (workspace:manage_tunnels); legacy header mcp-tunnels-2026-05-19 with org:manage_tunnels allowed during migration.

Added deprecated Admin API endpoint POST /v1/organizations/tunnels/{tunnel_id}/rotate_token?beta=true to rotate a tunnel token. Invalidates the current token for new connections and returns a new token; existing connections remain active. Accepts optional reason for audit. Superseded by /v1/tunnels with anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22 and WIF token (workspace:manage_tunnels). Existing integrations may continue using mcp-tunnels-2026-05-19 and org:manage_tunnels during migration.

Adds GET /v1/organizations/tunnels/{tunnel_id}?beta=true, a deprecated Admin API endpoint to fetch a single tunnel by ID in the caller's organization. Superseded by /v1/tunnels (use anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22).

Added deprecated Admin API endpoint GET /v1/organizations/tunnels?beta=true to list organization tunnels with pagination, workspace_id filtering, and optional include_archived; superseded by /v1/tunnels.
Beta endpoint to retrieve daily aggregated Claude Code usage metrics (per actor) for a specific UTC date, with pagination support.

Introduces a beta Admin API endpoint to retrieve paginated, time-bucketed Messages usage for an organization with flexible filters and grouping, returning token metrics, cache stats, server tool usage, and pagination cursors.
Added beta DELETE /v1/organizations/users/{user_id}?beta=true to remove a member from the organization; returns user_deleted on success.

Introduces GET /v1/organizations/users/{user_id}?beta=true to retrieve an organization member by user ID, returning a BetaUser object. Supports x-api-key and anthropic-version headers; 4XX returns BetaErrorResponse.
Added beta endpoint POST /v1/organizations/users/{user_id}?beta=true to update a member's organization role via JSON body { role }, returning the updated user.

Adds a beta endpoint to list organization members with pagination and optional filters by email and roles. Supports before_id, after_id, limit, email, and roles[] query params; returns a paginated ListResponse[User]. Requires Admin API key (x-api-key) and optional anthropic-version header.
Adds a beta endpoint to archive a workspace by ID; returns the updated Workspace (BetaWorkspace). Available via ?beta=true and supports optional anthropic-version header.

Adds a beta DELETE endpoint to remove a user (user_id) from a workspace (workspace_id). Requires Admin API key header; supports anthropic-version; returns workspace_member_deleted on success; standard error schema on failure. Route is accessed with ?beta=true.

Adds a beta GET endpoint to retrieve a specific workspace member by user_id within a workspace, returning a workspace_member object (user_id, workspace_id, workspace_role) or a BetaErrorResponse on errors. Supports x-api-key and anthropic-version headers.

Introduces POST /v1/organizations/workspaces/{workspace_id}/members/{user_id}?beta=true to update a workspace member’s role. Requires JSON body with workspace_role and returns the updated workspace_member. Supports optional anthropic-version header; standard 4XX error responses.
Beta endpoint to list members of a workspace with cursor pagination (before_id, after_id, limit); returns WorkspaceMember objects (user_id, workspace_id, workspace_role).
Adds POST /v1/organizations/workspaces/{workspace_id}/members?beta=true to create a workspace member by user_id and a non-billing workspace_role; returns the Workspace Member on success.

Beta endpoint to list workspace-level rate-limit overrides (one entry per group). Optional group_type filter. Returns only groups with overrides. Pagination fields included but currently all results are returned in a single page; follow next_page for future compatibility. Requires Admin API key.

Adds a beta DELETE endpoint to remove a service account from a workspace. Requires OAuth with org:admin scope (Admin API keys not accepted). Idempotent (200 if already removed). Deleting implicit default-workspace membership is a no-op; deleting an explicit default-workspace row reverts to implicit workspace_user. Archived workspaces return 400.

Adds a beta GET endpoint to retrieve a service account’s membership in a workspace, including its workspace_role. Requires OAuth token with org:admin scope; returns implicit membership for default workspace; archived workspaces return 400 and archived service accounts return 404.

Adds POST /v1/organizations/workspaces/{workspace_id}/service_accounts/{service_account_id}?beta=true to update a service account's workspace_role. Requires OAuth access token with org:admin scope (Admin API keys not accepted). Only explicit memberships can be updated; implicit default-workspace memberships require adding the service account explicitly first. Service accounts cannot hold workspace_billing. Archived workspaces return 400; archived service accounts cannot be updated. Request body: { workspace_role }. Response: ServiceAccountWorkspaceMember.

Adds beta GET /v1/organizations/workspaces/{workspace_id}/service_accounts?beta=true to list service accounts that are members of a workspace, including each account’s workspace_role, with pagination. Requires OAuth org:admin (Admin API keys not accepted). Archived workspaces return 400; implicit default-workspace membership and archived service accounts are excluded.

New beta endpoint to add a service account to a workspace with a specified workspace_role. Requires OAuth access token with org:admin scope (Admin API keys not accepted). If already a member, updates the role. Archived workspaces return 400; archived service accounts are rejected.

New beta endpoint GET /v1/organizations/workspaces/{workspace_id}?beta=true to retrieve a Workspace by ID. Returns BetaWorkspace on 200 and BetaErrorResponse on 4XX. Accepts workspace_id path param and optional x-api-key and anthropic-version headers.

Adds a beta POST endpoint to partially update a Workspace by ID. Accepts JSON body with optional fields (name, display_color, tags, data_residency, external_key_id; omitted fields unchanged), requires path param workspace_id, supports optional anthropic-version header, and returns a Workspace on success or a standardized 4XX error.
Beta endpoint to list organization Workspaces with pagination and optional include_archived filter.

Introduces beta endpoint POST /v1/organizations/workspaces?beta=true to create a Workspace with optional data residency settings, CMEK key attachment, display color, and tags; returns the created Workspace object.

Introduces beta GET /v1/deployment_runs/{deployment_run_id}?beta=true to retrieve a single deployment run record (BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentRun) by ID, including agent snapshot, trigger context, session_id or error.

Introduces beta GET /v1/deployment_runs to list deployment run records. Supports cursor pagination (limit, page) and filters (deployment_id, trigger_type, has_error, created_at[gte|lte|gt|lt]). Returns most recent runs first with data[] and next_page; 400 for invalid/expired page cursors and 200 with empty data for non‑existent deployment_id.

Adds a beta endpoint to archive a Managed Agents deployment by ID. POST /v1/deployments/{deployment_id}/archive?beta=true returns the updated deployment (BetaManagedAgentsDeployment) with archived_at set; standard BetaErrorResponse on errors.

Adds beta POST /v1/deployments/{deployment_id}/pause to manually pause a managed agent deployment. Returns the updated BetaManagedAgentsDeployment (status paused with paused_reason). Requires deployment_id path param; supports optional anthropic-version/anthropic-beta headers; standard error responses included.

Introduces a beta endpoint to immediately run a deployment by ID. Accepts optional anthropic-version and anthropic-beta headers. Returns a BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentRun record capturing the agent snapshot, trigger_context, created_at, and either session_id on success or an error object on failure. Standard 4xx/5xx error responses included.

Introduces a beta endpoint to unpause a Managed Agents deployment. Call POST /v1/deployments/{deployment_id}/unpause?beta=true to transition a paused deployment to active. Returns the updated BetaManagedAgentsDeployment on 200. Supports optional anthropic-version and anthropic-beta headers; requires deployment_id path param.

Introduces beta GET /v1/deployments/{deployment_id}?beta=true to fetch a Managed Agents deployment by ID, returning deployment details on 200 or BetaErrorResponse on errors; supports x-api-key, anthropic-version, and anthropic-beta headers.

Adds a beta endpoint to update a Managed Agents deployment by ID. Supports partial updates (agent, budget, description, environment_id, initial_events, metadata, name, resources, schedule, vault_ids) and returns the updated deployment object.

Introduces beta endpoint GET /v1/deployments?beta=true to list managed agent deployments with pagination and filters (agent_id, status, created_at range) and optional inclusion of archived items. Returns a paginated data array and next_page cursor.

Introduces POST /v1/deployments?beta=true to create a Managed Agents deployment, binding an agent to an environment, initial events, resources, optional schedule/budget, and vault credentials; returns a Deployment.

Introduces POST /v1/dreams/{dream_id}/archive?beta=true to archive a Dream by ID and return the updated BetaDream (research preview). Optional anthropic-version and anthropic-beta headers; standard error responses included.
Introduces POST /v1/dreams/{dream_id}/cancel?beta=true to cancel a Dream job by ID and return the updated BetaDream status; requires beta flag.
Adds research-preview GET /v1/dreams/{dream_id}?beta=true to retrieve a Dream job by ID, returning BetaDream details (status, inputs/outputs, usage) or BetaDreamingErrorResponse on errors.
New beta endpoint GET /v1/dreams?beta=true to list Dream jobs with filters and pagination; returns an array of Dream objects and a next_page token.

Introduces beta POST /v1/dreams to create a Dream: an async job that consolidates memories from memory stores and/or session transcripts into a memory store (new or existing), with model config, optional instructions, and detailed status/usage in the returned Dream resource.

Introduces a beta endpoint to archive a memory store by ID. On success, returns the store with archived_at set; archiving is one-way, makes the store read-only, and prevents attaching it to new sessions.
Introduces beta DELETE endpoint to remove a specific memory from a memory store, returning a memory_deleted tombstone. Supports optional expected_content_sha256 to enforce conditional deletion.

Introduces beta GET /v1/memory_stores/{memory_store_id}/memories/{memory_id} to retrieve a single memory by ID within a memory store. Supports optional view=basic|full (default full) to control whether content is returned; responds with a BetaManagedAgentsMemory.

Introduces a beta endpoint to update a memory by ID within a memory store. Supports updating content and/or renaming path, optional optimistic precondition (content_sha256), and view=basic|full. Returns the updated memory object; conflicts and precondition failures return 409.
Beta endpoint to list memories in a memory store with optional path_prefix, depth, pagination (limit/page), and view=basic|full; returns memory and memory_prefix items with next_page cursor.

New beta endpoint to create a memory in a specified memory store. Clients provide path and content in the request body; optional view=basic|full controls whether content is returned. Responds with a memory object; returns 409 memory_path_conflict_error if the path conflicts.

Adds beta POST /v1/memory_stores/{memory_store_id}/memory_versions/{memory_version_id}/redact to redact a memory version; sets redacted_at and nulls content, path, content_sha256, and content_size_bytes; returns the updated memory_version.

Introduces a beta GET endpoint to retrieve a specific memory version by ID within a memory store. Supports optional view=basic|full and returns a MemoryVersion object with attribution and redaction-aware fields.

Introduces beta GET /v1/memory_stores/{memory_store_id}/memory_versions to list memory version history with filters (memory_id, session_id, api_key_id, service_account_id, operation, created_at range), pagination (limit, page), and view (basic/full); returns data and next_page.
Introduces beta DELETE /v1/memory_stores/{memory_store_id}?beta=true to permanently delete a memory store and all its memories/versions; returns confirmation with the deleted store ID.
New beta GET endpoint to retrieve a memory store by ID, returning the full memory_store object (including archived stores). Requires path param memory_store_id and beta=true.
Introduces POST /v1/memory_stores/{memory_store_id}?beta=true to update a memory store’s name, description, and metadata; returns the updated memory_store object.

Adds beta endpoint GET /v1/memory_stores?beta=true to list memory stores. Supports pagination (limit, page/next_page), include_archived, and created_at[gte|lte] filters; returns an array of memory_store objects and a next_page cursor.

Introduces POST /v1/memory_stores?beta=true to create a memory_store (container for agent memories). Accepts JSON with name (required), optional description and metadata; returns the created store object.

Archives the specified thread (sets archived_at) and returns the updated BetaManagedAgentsSessionThread object. Route: POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/threads/{thread_id}/archive?beta=true. Supports optional anthropic-version and anthropic-beta headers and standard error responses.

Adds research-preview endpoint POST /v1/tunnels/{tunnel_id}/archive?beta=true to archive an MCP tunnel. Archival is irreversible: archives all non-archived certificates, retires the hostname (never re-allocated), and invalidates the tunnel token; retrying an already-archived tunnel returns the existing record. Requires header anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22. Returns the archived Tunnel on 200.

POST /v1/tunnels/{tunnel_id}/certificates/{certificate_id}/archive?beta=true archives a tunnel certificate, removing it from the trusted set while retaining the record. Archiving the last non-archived certificate is allowed; the tunnel rejects MCP traffic until a new certificate is added. Requires anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22 and returns the updated tunnel_certificate.

New beta endpoint to fetch a tunnel certificate by ID: GET /v1/tunnels/{tunnel_id}/certificates/{certificate_id}. Research preview; requires anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22 header. Returns a BetaTunnelCertificate.

Adds GET /v1/tunnels/{tunnel_id}/certificates?beta=true to list a tunnel's registered certificates with pagination; archived certificates excluded unless include_archived=true. Research preview requiring header anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22.

New beta endpoint POST /v1/tunnels/{tunnel_id}/certificates?beta=true registers a public CA certificate (PEM) to a tunnel for inner TLS verification; requires header anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22 and returns the created tunnel_certificate.

Introduces POST /v1/tunnels/{tunnel_id}/reveal_token (beta) to reveal a tunnel's live connector token; requires anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22 and returns a tunnel_token with a stable id until rotation.

New beta route POST /v1/tunnels/{tunnel_id}/rotate_token?beta=true to rotate a tunnel's connector token. Invalidates old token for new connections (existing stay up) and returns a fresh token. Requires header anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22. Optional JSON body field 'reason'.

New research-preview endpoint to fetch an MCP tunnel by ID: GET /v1/tunnels/{tunnel_id}?beta=true. Returns a BetaTunnel. Requires header anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22 and supersedes Admin API /v1/organizations/tunnels during migration.
Adds GET /v1/tunnels (research preview) to list MCP tunnels ordered by newest first, with pagination and optional include_archived; requires header anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22.

Adds POST /v1/tunnels?beta=true to create an MCP tunnel. Requires header anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22. Allocates a unique hostname and provisions the tunnel; operation is not idempotent. Newly created tunnels reject MCP traffic until at least one CA certificate is added. Research preview; supersedes Admin API /v1/organizations/tunnels.

New GET /assets/characters endpoint listing character collections in the user's Assets library with limit/offset pagination.

Introduces POST /assets/characters to create a character in the user's fal Assets library. Requires name, description, and reference_images (prefer vector/request IDs; fal-hosted URLs for standalone). Unresolved ID references are materialized before character state is added. Supports Idempotency-Key and returns 201 with the created character.
New endpoint to delete a character asset by ID from the authenticated user's Assets library.

Adds POST /assets/characters/{character_id}/favorite to mark a character as favorited for the authenticated user and returns the updated character (is_favorited=true). Supports optional Idempotency-Key for safe retries.
Adds GET /assets/characters/{character_id} to retrieve a user's asset character details by ID; returns a character object on success with standard error schema on failure. Requires apiKey auth.

Adds PATCH /assets/characters/{character_id} to update an asset character (name, description, cover image, reference images). Prefer vector/request IDs in reference_images; supports optional Idempotency-Key.

Adds POST /assets/characters/{character_id}/unfavorite to remove a character from the authenticated user's favorites. Accepts character_id path param and optional Idempotency-Key; returns the updated character (is_favorited=false).
Introduces GET /assets/collections to list the authenticated user's asset collections with optional limit/offset pagination.
Adds POST /assets/collections to create a new asset collection in the user's library; requires name, supports optional fields and Idempotency-Key, returns the created collection (201).

Adds DELETE /assets/collections/{collection_id}/assets to remove an asset from a manual or character collection. Provide exactly one of asset_id, request_id, or vector_id; returns 204 on success (removes explicit smart-entity link for character collections).
New GET /assets/collections/{collection_id}/assets endpoint to list a user's collection assets with pagination, filtering, and hybrid semantic search (text/image/video).

Introduces POST /assets/collections/{collection_id}/assets to add an asset to manual or character collections using exactly one of asset_id, request_id, or vector_id. Unresolved request/vector IDs are materialized as assets before adding; character collections create a smart-entity link. Supports optional Idempotency-Key and returns { success: boolean }.
Adds DELETE /assets/collections/{collection_id} to delete an authenticated user's asset collection; returns 204 on success and supports optional Idempotency-Key.
Introduces POST /assets/collections/{collection_id}/favorite to favorite a collection for the authenticated user; returns the collection with is_favorited=true.

New GET /assets/collections/{collection_id} endpoint to retrieve a single asset collection for the authenticated user, returning collection metadata (e.g., id, type, name, description, icon/color/cover, character_identifier, parent_collection_id, is_favorited, timestamps).
Adds GET /assets/collections/{collection_id}/hierarchy to retrieve the nested subtree for a collection along with its ancestor collections ordered from the top level to the direct parent.

Adds POST /assets/collections/{collection_id}/move to relocate a manual collection under another manual collection or to the top level; enforces max nesting depth 5 and prevents cycles; supports optional Idempotency-Key.

Adds PATCH /assets/collections/{collection_id} to update a user's asset collection (name, description, color, icon, cover_image_url, filters). Supports optional Idempotency-Key header and returns the updated collection. Secured with API key.
Unfavorites the specified asset collection for the authenticated user; returns the updated collection with is_favorited=false. Supports optional Idempotency-Key for safe retries.
Introduces POST /assets/favorite to mark an asset as favorited; accepts asset_id or resolves request_id/vector_id to an asset and returns is_favorited.

Introduces GET /assets to browse and semantically search assets (image, video, audio, 3d) using text/image/video queries, with filters (media_type, source, section, collection_id, tag_id with any/all, character_identifier) and pagination (limit, cursor). Returns paginated results with similarity scores and metadata.
Added GET /assets/tags to list asset tags for the authenticated user's Assets library.

Adds POST /assets/tags to create a new asset tag in the authenticated user's Assets library. Accepts JSON body with name (1-50 chars) and optional Idempotency-Key header; returns the created tag on 201.

Adds PUT /assets/tags to fully replace an asset’s tags. Accepts asset_id or a request_id/vector_id (unresolved refs are materialized before tagging). Returns the resulting tag list; supports Idempotency-Key for safe retries.
Adds DELETE /assets/tags/{tag_id}/assign to unassign a tag from an asset (by asset_id, request_id, or vector_id); returns 204 on success.
Adds POST /assets/tags/{tag_id}/assign to assign a tag to an asset; accepts asset_id or resolves request_id/vector_id to an asset; supports optional Idempotency-Key; returns { success: boolean }.

New endpoint DELETE /assets/tags/{tag_id} deletes an asset tag from the authenticated user's Assets library. Returns 204 No Content on success; supports optional Idempotency-Key header and standard error responses.
New endpoint PATCH /assets/tags/{tag_id} to update a tag's name in the authenticated user's Assets library; accepts JSON { name }, supports optional Idempotency-Key, and returns the updated tag.
Adds POST /assets/unfavorite to remove favorite status by asset_id, request_id, or vector_id; responds with is_favorited=false on success.

Introduces POST /assets/uploads to ingest a fal-hosted media URL into the authenticated user's Assets library with optional collection, tags, prompt, and favorite; returns the created asset on success.
Introduces GET /assets/{asset_id} to fetch an authenticated user's asset by asset_id or vector_id, returning asset metadata and URL; 404 if not found.

Adds GET /assets/{asset_id}/lineage to retrieve an asset’s derivation lineage graph, including inputs, generation requests, and referenced entities, traversed recursively up to a depth limit (default/max 5). Deleted/expired ancestors appear as tombstones; uncaptured inputs appear as external inputs.
Adds GET /assets/{asset_id}/tags to list tags for an asset by asset ID or vector ID; returns an empty list if no live catalog record exists.

New enterprise-only admin endpoint GET /organization/billing-events that returns paginated, organization-wide Model API billing event records across all teams with per-request USD cost breakdown. Supports filtering by team_username, endpoint_id, api_key_id, request_id, and date range (up to 90 days), cursor-based pagination (limit up to 100), and optional auth_method/auth_method_structured expansions. Requires an admin API key on the organization’s root team.

Adds GET /organization/focus to download a FOCUS-compliant billing CSV across the org (or a single team). Supports source=invoice (by billing_month or charge_month) and source=estimate (date-range). Requires admin API key on the org’s root team.
Adds GET /organization/teams to list all teams in an organization with created_at, name, username, and is_org_root; enterprise-only and requires admin API key on the org’s root team.

Adds organization-wide usage endpoint (GET /organization/usage). Returns paginated time series and/or summary usage across all teams and products (model_apis, serverless, compute) with per-team and per-product attribution; filterable by team, product, endpoint, API key, date range, and auth method. Requires admin API key on the org root team; enterprise-only.

Adds GET /serverless/apps/{owner}/{name}/events to return an app's operational event history (deployments, config changes, runner lifecycle), newest first; supports time range and category filters with cursor pagination; requires API key and owner access.

Adds GET /serverless/apps/{owner}/{name}/revisions to list an app’s revision history (newest first) with creation time, current flag, deploy status/deployed_by, message, annotations, and pagination (limit/cursor); API key auth, owner-only.

Introduces GET /organizations/{organizationId}/endpoints to list endpoints shared across all projects in an organization (internal visibility). Supports pagination (limit, after), sorting (orderBy created_at/updated_at asc|desc), and filtering by name/created_at/updated_at; excludes project-private and public endpoints.
New endpoint to list custom models shared across all projects in an organization; excludes project-private and public models; supports pagination via limit and after.

New GET /projects/{projectId}/configs endpoint listing production-ready config revisions compatible with a reference model (via referenceModel or deprecated referenceModelId), including public and project-owned configs with pagination.
Adds GET /projects/{projectId}/configs/{id} to retrieve a model configuration revision by ID, including its selectors and certifications.

Introduces GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints to list a project's dedicated inference endpoints, supporting pagination (limit/after), sorting (orderBy), and advanced filtering (filter). Returns a list with endpoint summaries and next_cursor.
Introduces POST /projects/{projectId}/endpoints to create a stable, inference-addressable endpoint within a project; accepts name and optional visibility and returns endpoint details.
Introduces GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/abExperiments to list managed live-traffic A/B experiments for an endpoint with pagination (limit, after).

Adds POST /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/abExperiments to create a managed A/B experiment that splits control traffic among 2-20 deployments (exactly one control) with integer percentages summing to 100; returns the created ABExperiment.

Adds DELETE /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/abExperiments/{id} to delete an A/B experiment and remove its managed traffic split (deployments remain). Optional etag for concurrency; returns empty object on success.

Introduces GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/abExperiments/{id} to retrieve an A/B experiment, including participating deployments (control/variants), their roles, and traffic percentages.

New PATCH /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/abExperiments/{id} to update an A/B experiment’s description or member traffic percentages. Supports updateMask and optimistic concurrency via etag; returns updated DE.ABExperiment on success.

Adds GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/deployments to list an endpoint’s deployments with model, config, autoscaling, placement, and status; supports pagination, sorting, and filtering.
Creates a model deployment under an endpoint; provisions asynchronously; supports validateOnly; returns deployment.
Adds GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/deployments/{deploymentId}/adapters to list LoRA adapters on a deployment with per-cluster load state; supports pagination via limit and after.

POST /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/deployments/{deploymentId}/adapters attaches a LoRA adapter to a deployment; if at capacity, setting force evicts the oldest adapter and returns the adapter entry with load status.

New endpoint: DELETE /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/deployments/{deploymentId}/adapters/{id} detaches an adapter from a deployment using a required etag for optimistic concurrency; returns empty JSON on success.
Added GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/deployments/{deploymentId}/adapters/{id} to retrieve an attached adapter and its per-cluster load state (returns DE.AdapterEntry).
New endpoint PATCH /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/deployments/{deploymentId}/adapters/{id} updates the pinned adapter revision using row-level etag for optimistic concurrency.

New DELETE /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/deployments/{id} to permanently delete a deployment from its endpoint. Supports optional etag for optimistic concurrency; returns empty object on success. Ensure deployment is removed from live traffic first.
New route GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/deployments/{id} retrieves a deployment's configuration, placement, runtime info, autoscaling, and current provisioning status.

Adds PATCH /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/deployments/{id} to update mutable deployment settings (model, config, autoscaling, LoRA). May trigger async reprovisioning; supports updateMask and etag.
Added GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/rollouts to list rollout histories for an endpoint with pagination and optional filtering for active or terminal rollouts.

Adds POST /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/rollouts to create a rollout in the PENDING state without shifting traffic. Supports blue-green, canary (with optional metric gates), and rolling strategies between sourceDeploymentId and targetDeploymentId; returns a Rollout and must be started separately.

Adds POST /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/rollouts/preview-defaults to preview defaulted rollout create-form values and capacity context without creating a rollout; responses are display-only and re-validated at create/start.
Adds POST /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/rollouts/{id}/cancel to cancel a running or paused rollout by freezing current traffic; requires a reason and returns the rollout snapshot.
New route to delete a rollout record. Active rollouts must be aborted or completed first; supports optional etag for optimistic concurrency; returns empty DeleteResponse on success.

Added GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/rollouts/{id} to retrieve a rollout's strategy, lifecycle state, current traffic percent, step history, and metric-gate results (returns DE.Rollout).

Adds POST /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/rollouts/{id}/pause to request pausing a running or stabilizing rollout with optional etag and reason; returns a DE.Rollout in PAUSING and clients should poll GetRollout until PAUSED.

Adds POST /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/rollouts/{id}/promote to immediately complete a running/paused rollout by routing 100% traffic to the target deployment; supports optional etag for concurrency control.

Adds POST /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/rollouts/{id}/resume to resume a pausing, paused, or system-paused rollout from its current step and traffic split. Accepts optional etag for concurrency; returns DE.Rollout.
Introduces POST /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/rollouts/{id}/start to start a pending rollout and begin its configured traffic-shifting workflow; returns DE.Rollout on success.

Adds GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/shadowExperiments to list shadow experiments that mirror sampled endpoint traffic to target deployments without affecting client responses; supports pagination (limit/after) and includeTargets=true to inline target details.

Added POST /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/shadowExperiments to create a shadow experiment that mirrors a sampled portion of endpoint traffic to one or more target deployments without affecting client responses. Returns the created ShadowExperiment; request requires name and source and can include initial targets.

Added GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/shadowExperiments/{experimentId}/targets to list deployments receiving mirrored traffic for a shadow experiment; supports limit/after pagination.

Adds POST /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/shadowExperiments/{experimentId}/targets to create a shadow experiment target that mirrors traffic to a specified deployment under the same endpoint.

Added DELETE /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/shadowExperiments/{experimentId}/targets/{id} to remove a target from a shadow experiment without deleting the underlying deployment; supports optional etag for optimistic concurrency; returns an empty object on success.
New GET route retrieves a specific shadow experiment target by id, returning DE.ShadowExperimentTarget (200) or ErrorData on errors.
Adds PATCH endpoint to update a shadow experiment target’s name, targetDeploymentId, or description; requires updateMask and supports ETag for optimistic concurrency. Returns the updated target.

Adds DELETE /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/shadowExperiments/{id} to delete a shadow experiment and its target records; underlying deployments are not deleted. Supports optional etag for optimistic concurrency and returns an empty object on success.
Adds GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/shadowExperiments/{id} to retrieve a shadow experiment, including its sampling strategy and target deployments.

Adds PATCH /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{endpointId}/shadowExperiments/{id} to update a shadow experiment’s description or source sampling strategy. Requires updateMask; source updates also require the current etag in the request body.

Introduces GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{id}/analytics to retrieve aggregated endpoint metrics (requests, tokens, latency, throughput, errors, resource utilization) over a time range, with optional time-series buckets and per-deployment breakdown.
Introduces DELETE /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{id} to permanently delete an endpoint; supports optional etag for optimistic concurrency and requires deleting deployments first.

Adds GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{id}/events to list an endpoint’s combined audit and lifecycle events (newest first), including endpoint- and deployment-scoped events. Supports filtering by event types, minimum severity, time range, deployment IDs, source kinds, and subject ID; pagination via limit and after. Returns a list of events with next_cursor.
Added GET /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{id} to retrieve an endpoint and lightweight summaries of its deployments.
Adds PATCH /projects/{projectId}/endpoints/{id} to update mutable endpoint fields (name, visibility, trafficSplit) using updateMask and etag for optimistic concurrency; returns the updated endpoint.
Introduces GET /projects/{projectId}/models to list custom model resources owned by a project, with optional visibility and organization filters and pagination (limit/after).
Added POST /projects/{projectId}/models to register a custom model in a project; creates metadata only—upload/import model files separately; returns DE.Model on success.

Adds GET /projects/{projectId}/models/uploads to list a project's remote model import jobs (from Hugging Face or presigned URLs) with optional pagination via limit and after; returns a list object containing RemoteUpload jobs and next_cursor.

Adds POST /projects/{projectId}/models/uploads to start an async job that imports model files from a Hugging Face repo or presigned URL into a registered model and creates a model revision upon completion.
New GET /projects/{projectId}/models/uploads/{id}/events to list progress and diagnostic events for a remote model import job; supports limit and after cursor for pagination.
Introduces GET /projects/{projectId}/models/uploads/{id} to fetch remote model import job details, including status, messages, retry counts, and timestamps.
Introduces DELETE /projects/{projectId}/models/{id} to permanently delete a custom model not in use by an active deployment; returns an empty object on success (200) or ErrorData on failure.

Introduces GET /projects/{projectId}/models/{id}/files to list files in the latest or specified model revision, returning each file’s path, sizeBytes, and hash, plus pagination cursor and revision metadata.
Adds GET /projects/{projectId}/models/{id} to fetch a project's custom model details: metadata, visibility, weights, and base-model relationship.
Adds PATCH /projects/{projectId}/models/{id} to update a model's mutable metadata (name, description, visibility); supports updateMask for partial updates.
Introduces GET /projects/{projectId}/models/{id}/revisions to list a model’s immutable revisions (newest first), with pagination and validation metadata.

Adds GET /projects/{projectId}/models/{id}/revisions/{revisionId} to retrieve metadata for a specific immutable model volume revision, including creation time, last validation time, validation status, and any validation errors.
Adds a new endpoint to list reusable, project-visible placement profiles with pagination.
Add GET /projects/{projectId}/placement-profiles/{id} to retrieve a placement profile with its ordered region preferences.

New GET /public/endpoints lists publicly visible endpoints across Together projects, supporting pagination (limit/after), sorting (orderBy), and advanced filtering (filter); returns a list of public endpoints with next_cursor.
Adds GET /public/inference-instance-types to list available inference hardware types, including GPU specs, pricing, regions, and best-effort capacity headroom.
Adds GET /public/inference-instance-types/{id} to fetch GPU specs, pricing, regions, and capacity headroom for a single inference instance type by ID.

Adds POST /v1/flux-tools/deblur-v1: submit an async task to remove blur by regenerating the input image with a fixed FLUX.2 deblur model. Accepts base64/URL image plus optional output_format, safety_tolerance, seed, and webhook; returns a polling URL or webhook-based status.

Adds POST /v1/flux-tools/erase-v1 to remove objects/regions from an image using a provided mask; supports mask dilation, output format, safety tolerance, optional seed, and webhooks; returns async polling or webhook response.

Adds an async endpoint to outpaint/extend an image by placing the input image on a width×height canvas at optional x/y offsets and generating the surrounding region with a FLUX outpainting model. Supports input_image (URL or base64), width, height, mode (high|fast), optional prompt, auto_crop, output_format, safety_tolerance; returns polling URL or uses webhook.

Adds POST /v1/flux-tools/video-upscale-v1: submits an async video upscaling task (1.5–3x) for the first 20s of an MP4 (URL or base64). Output frames capped at 13.75 MP; supports precise (0) or creative (1) mode via creativity, optional prompt, safety_tolerance, and webhook callbacks.
Adds POST /v1/flux-tools/vto-v1 to submit virtual try-on tasks using person and garment images with prompt steering; returns async polling response or webhook callbacks.

Adds POST /v1/flux-tools/vto-v2 to submit virtual try-on tasks using the FLUX.2 Klein VTO v2 model. Accepts person and garment images plus a prompt, supports output up to 4MP, and returns async job info or webhook status.

Adds a beta endpoint to archive a managed agent by ID and return the updated agent (archived_at populated).
Adds a beta endpoint to list versions of a Managed Agents agent by ID with pagination (limit, page). Returns a paginated array of agent versions and a next_page cursor.

Introduces beta GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}?beta=true to fetch a Managed Agents agent by ID, with optional version query, returning the agent’s full definition (model, tools, skills, MCP servers, metadata).

Adds a beta endpoint to update a Managed Agents agent by ID. Requires the current version for concurrency safety and supports updating name, description, model/model_config, system, tools, skills, MCP servers, and metadata (patch). Arrays are full-replacement; empty or null clears where allowed. Returns the updated agent object.

Introduces GET /v1/agents?beta=true to list managed agents with pagination (limit/page), creation-time filters (created_at[gte|lte]), and optional inclusion of archived agents; returns a paginated list with next_page cursor.
New beta endpoint to create a Managed Agents agent. Accepts required name/model and optional configuration (system, tools, skills, MCP servers, metadata); returns the created agent object.
Introduces beta POST /v1/environments/{environment_id}/archive to archive an environment by ID; returns a BetaEnvironment. Archived environments cannot create new sessions.
Added beta endpoint DELETE /v1/environments/{environment_id}?beta=true to delete an environment by ID; returns a confirmation object on success.

Introduces beta endpoint GET /v1/environments/{environment_id}?beta=true to retrieve an environment by ID. Returns BetaEnvironment on 200 success and BetaErrorResponse on 4XX. Supports anthropic-beta and anthropic-version headers; accepts x-api-key or sessionKey for auth.

Added beta route POST /v1/environments/{environment_id}?beta=true to update an existing environment's configuration. Requires JSON body BetaPublicEnvironmentUpdateRequest (name, description, metadata, and cloud config options like networking and packages). Returns BetaEnvironment on 200; 4XX returns BetaErrorResponse. Optional headers: anthropic-beta, anthropic-version.

Introduces beta List Environments endpoint (GET /v1/environments?beta=true) to list environments with cursor-based pagination (limit, page), optional include_archived, and beta/version headers; returns BetaEnvironmentListResponse on success and BetaErrorResponse on errors.

Introduces beta POST /v1/environments?beta=true to create a new environment with cloud networking and package configuration. Returns an Environment object on success; supports optional anthropic-beta and anthropic-version headers; 4XX returns an error response.

Introduces a beta endpoint to archive a Managed Agents session by ID; returns the updated session object with archived_at set.

Adds GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}/events/stream?beta=true to stream managed agent session events in real time. Emits typed events for user/agent messages, tool use/results (custom, MCP, built-in), thinking, session status changes, model request spans with usage, errors, and session.deleted. Accepts session_id path param and optional headers x-api-key, anthropic-version, and anthropic-beta.
Introduces GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}/events?beta=true to list a session's events with pagination (limit/page) and optional order (asc/desc), returning typed session event records.

Introduces beta endpoint POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/events to send events to a Managed Agents session (user.message, user.interrupt, user.tool_confirmation, user.custom_tool_result). Accepts JSON body with events array and returns the sent events. Supports optional anthropic-version and anthropic-beta headers; includes standard error responses.
Adds beta endpoint DELETE /v1/sessions/{session_id}/resources/{resource_id}?beta=true to delete a session resource and return a confirmation object (id, type=session_resource_deleted) on success.
New beta endpoint GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}/resources/{resource_id} to retrieve a specific session resource (file or GitHub repository) and its metadata.

Introduces POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/resources/{resource_id}?beta=true to update a session resource. Accepts JSON with authorization_token to rotate credentials (currently only for github_repository). Returns the updated resource (type github_repository or file).

Adds beta GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}/resources to list resources attached to a session, with optional pagination via limit and page. Returns paginated data (files and GitHub repositories) and next_page cursor.

Introduces POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/resources?beta=true to attach resources to a session. Currently supports mounting an uploaded file (type=file) by file_id with optional mount_path; returns the created session resource with id, file_id, mount_path, and timestamps.
Adds beta DELETE /v1/sessions/{session_id}?beta=true to permanently delete a session by ID and return a session_deleted confirmation object.

Introduces beta endpoint GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}?beta=true to fetch a Managed Agents session by ID, returning a BetaManagedAgentsSession (agent snapshot, resources, status, usage, stats). Supports optional x-api-key, anthropic-version, and anthropic-beta headers with standard error responses.

Adds beta endpoint POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}?beta=true to update a Managed Agents session. Supports patch-style updates to title and metadata (metadata keys can be set or deleted via null). 'vault_ids' is reserved and requests setting it are rejected. Returns the updated session object on success.

Introduces a beta GET /v1/sessions endpoint to list Managed Agents sessions with pagination and rich filters. Supports limit, cursor pagination via page/next_page, include_archived (default false), created_at time range filters (gte/gt/lte/lt, RFC 3339), agent_id and agent_version filtering, and order by created_at (asc|desc, default desc). Returns a paginated data array of session objects plus next_page; standard error responses included.

Introduces POST /v1/sessions?beta=true to create a Managed Agents session (beta). Requires agent and environment_id; optional title, metadata, resources, and vault_ids. Returns the created session with agent snapshot, resources, status, stats, and usage.
Beta endpoint to archive a vault by ID. POST without body; returns the updated vault resource.

New beta route to archive a credential in a vault. POST /v1/vaults/{vault_id}/credentials/{credential_id}/archive?beta=true. Soft-archives the credential and returns the updated BetaManagedAgentsCredential; errors return BetaErrorResponse.
Adds beta-only DELETE /v1/vaults/{vault_id}/credentials/{credential_id}?beta=true to remove a credential from a vault; returns a vault_credential_deleted confirmation on success.

Added beta GET /v1/vaults/{vault_id}/credentials/{credential_id} to retrieve a specific vault credential by ID. Returns BetaManagedAgentsCredential with non-sensitive fields and standard error responses.

Adds a beta POST endpoint to update an existing vault credential by ID, allowing changes to display_name, metadata (patch semantics), and auth configuration (type immutable; supports static_bearer and mcp_oauth). Returns the updated credential on success.

Introduces beta GET /v1/vaults/{vault_id}/credentials?beta=true to list credentials in a vault. Supports pagination via limit and page, and include_archived filter. Returns a paginated list of credential metadata (no secrets).

Introduces POST /v1/vaults/{vault_id}/credentials?beta=true to create a credential in a vault. Accepts auth config (static_bearer or mcp_oauth with optional refresh), plus optional display_name and metadata; returns a vault_credential without sensitive fields. Supports anthropic-version and anthropic-beta headers; standard error responses on failure.
Introduces a beta DELETE endpoint to permanently delete a vault by ID and returns a vault_deleted confirmation object on success.
Introduces GET /v1/vaults/{vault_id}?beta=true to retrieve a vault by ID (beta), returning vault details including display_name, metadata, and timestamps.

Added beta endpoint POST /v1/vaults/{vault_id}?beta=true to update an existing vault by ID. Accepts JSON body with optional display_name (1–255 chars) and a metadata patch (set string to upsert, null to delete). Returns the updated vault object. Supports optional headers anthropic-version and anthropic-beta.

Adds beta GET /v1/vaults?beta=true to list vaults with pagination. Supports limit, page, and include_archived; returns data and next_page. Optional headers: x-api-key, anthropic-version, anthropic-beta.

Introduces POST /v1/vaults?beta=true to create a vault storing credentials for managed agents. Accepts display_name and optional metadata; returns a vault object (id, display_name, metadata, timestamps). Includes standard error responses.

New endpoint GET /v1/workflows/deployments to list workflow deployments. Supports active_only (default true) and workflow_name query filters; returns a deployments array of DeploymentResponse objects (id, name, is_active, created_at, updated_at).
Adds GET /v1/workflows/deployments/{name} to retrieve a workflow deployment by name, returning id, name, active status, timestamps, and registered workers.

Introduces GET /v1/workflows/events/list to retrieve workflow event history with optional filters (root_workflow_exec_id, workflow_exec_id, workflow_run_id), limit (default 100), and cursor-based pagination. Returns typed workflow, custom task, and activity events plus next_cursor.

Introduces GET /v1/workflows/events/stream, a Server-Sent Events (SSE) endpoint that streams real-time workflow and activity events with rich filtering (scope, workflow/activity identifiers, stream, start_seq, metadata, event types) and Last-Event-Id resume support.
New POST /v1/workflows/executions/cancel endpoint to batch-cancel workflow executions. Accepts JSON body with execution_ids (1–100) and returns per-execution status/error results.

Introduces POST /v1/workflows/executions/terminate to batch-terminate workflow executions by ID. Accepts a JSON body with execution_ids (1–100) and returns per-execution results with status and optional error.
Introduces POST /v1/workflows/executions/{execution_id}/cancel to cancel a workflow execution by ID. Returns 204 No Content on success; 422 for validation errors.
Adds GET /v1/workflows/executions/{execution_id} to fetch workflow execution details (status, times, result, IDs, duration).

Introduces GET /v1/workflows/executions/{execution_id}/history to retrieve a workflow execution’s event history, with optional payload decoding via decode_payloads (boolean, default false). Returns JSON on success; 422 on validation errors.

New POST /v1/workflows/executions/{execution_id}/queries to run a named query against a workflow execution by ID. Accepts JSON body with 'name' and optional 'input' (object or network-encoded). Returns 200 with 'query_name' and 'result'.
Introduces POST /v1/workflows/executions/{execution_id}/reset to reset a workflow execution to a specified event_id, optionally excluding subsequent signals/updates; returns 204 on success.

Adds POST /v1/workflows/executions/{execution_id}/signals to send a named signal to a workflow execution by ID. Body includes required 'name' and optional 'input' (JSON or network-encoded). Responds 202 on acceptance or 422 on validation errors.

Adds GET /v1/workflows/executions/{execution_id}/stream: a Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream) endpoint to stream workflow execution events for a given execution_id. Supports optional event_source=LIVE|DATABASE and last_event_id to resume; emits StreamEventSsePayload events (workflow and task/activity lifecycle updates).
Adds POST /v1/workflows/executions/{execution_id}/terminate to immediately terminate a workflow execution by ID. Returns 204 No Content on success and 422 for validation errors. No request body.

Introduces GET /v1/workflows/executions/{execution_id}/trace/events to fetch a workflow execution’s trace events and metadata, with optional merging of same-id events and inclusion of internal events.

Introduces GET /v1/workflows/executions/{execution_id}/trace/otel to fetch a workflow execution's OpenTelemetry trace and related metadata. Returns WorkflowExecutionTraceOTelResponse (Tempo-compatible trace batches, status, timing, IDs, result). 422 on validation errors.

Adds a beta endpoint to retrieve a workflow execution's trace summary by execution_id, returning execution metadata (status, start/end time, total duration, result, parent/root IDs, workflow_name) and an optional span_tree with spans and events.
Adds POST /v1/workflows/executions/{execution_id}/updates to request a named update on a specific workflow execution, accepting JSON or network-encoded input and returning the update_name and result.

Adds GET /v1/workflows/registrations to list workflow registrations with filtering (by workflow_id, task_queue, name, archived state, active_only, include_shared, available_in_chat_assistant), optional inclusion of workflow definition (with_workflow), and pagination via limit/cursor. Returns WorkflowRegistrationListResponse on 200; 422 on validation errors.

Adds deprecated POST /v1/workflows/registrations/{workflow_registration_id}/execute to start a registered workflow by ID; supports input or encoded_input, optional deployment_name, wait_for_result for sync/async, returning execution metadata or direct result.

New endpoint to retrieve a workflow registration by ID. Optional query params: with_workflow (include workflow definition) and include_shared (include shared workflow versions). Returns WorkflowRegistrationGetResponse.
Added GET /v1/workflows/runs to list workflow executions with optional filters (workflow, search, status) and pagination (page_size, next_page_token). Returns executions and next_page_token.

Introduces GET /v1/workflows/runs/{run_id} to retrieve workflow execution details (status, start/end times, duration, result, and execution IDs) as a WorkflowExecutionResponse; returns 200 on success or 422 for validation errors.

Adds GET /v1/workflows/runs/{run_id}/history to retrieve a workflow run’s history by run_id. Optional query decode_payloads (bool, default false) returns decoded payloads. Responds with JSON (200) or validation errors (422).

Introduces GET /v1/workflows/schedules to list workflow schedules (beta), returning a schedules array with schedule details (ids, timing via cron/calendars/intervals, policy, and optional time bounds).
Introduces POST /v1/workflows/schedules to create a workflow schedule using a ScheduleDefinition and returns a schedule_id on success.
Introduces DELETE /v1/workflows/schedules/{schedule_id} to unschedule a workflow by schedule_id. Returns 204 on success; 422 on validation error.
Added GET /v1/workflows/workers/whoami to return worker info: namespace, scheduler URL, and TLS flag.
Introduces PUT /v1/workflows/{workflow_identifier}/archive to archive a workflow and return the updated workflow spec (WorkflowArchiveResponse).

Introduces POST /v1/workflows/{workflow_identifier}/execute to run a workflow with optional synchronous result; accepts input or encoded payload, optional deployment_name, custom execution_id, and returns either execution details or the direct result depending on wait_for_result.
Introduces GET /v1/workflows/{workflow_identifier} to retrieve a workflow by its identifier and return its details.

New PUT /v1/workflows/{workflow_identifier} endpoint to update a workflow's metadata (display_name, description, available_in_chat_assistant) and return the updated Workflow; responds with 200 on success or 422 on validation errors.
Adds PUT /v1/workflows/{workflow_identifier}/unarchive to unarchive a workflow and return its Workflow in WorkflowUnarchiveResponse.

Adds GET /v1/workflows/{workflow_name}/metrics to retrieve comprehensive workflow metrics with optional start_time and end_time filters, returning execution/error/success counts, average_latency_ms, retry_rate, and latency_over_time.
200 response example updated: usage now shows input/output token fields (ModelUsage) instead of prompt/completion token fields.
Updated TranslationDTO.error description to clarify it's null when success=true and changed wording from 'addon' to 'model'.

Added GET /v1/observability/campaigns to retrieve all campaigns with pagination and optional search. Supports page_size (0–100, default 50), page (default 1), and q. Returns CampaignPreviews (paginated CampaignPreview results). Error responses: 400, 404, 408, 409, 422.

Adds POST /v1/observability/campaigns (beta) to create and start a campaign. Accepts PostCampaignInSchema (name 5–50 chars, description, judge_id UUID, max_nb_events >0 up to 10000, search_params filters). Returns 201 with CampaignPreview on success; possible errors: 400, 404, 408, 409, 422.
Adds DELETE /v1/observability/campaigns/{campaign_id} to permanently delete a campaign by UUID. Returns 204 on success; 400/404/408/409/422 return ObservabilityError.
Introduces GET /v1/observability/campaigns/{campaign_id} to retrieve a campaign by UUID. Returns 200 with CampaignPreview; errors (400, 404, 408, 409, 422) return ObservabilityError.

Adds GET /v1/observability/campaigns/{campaign_id}/selected-events to fetch a paginated list of chat completion events selected by a campaign, including event IDs and basic metadata; supports page and page_size.
Introduces GET /v1/observability/campaigns/{campaign_id}/status to retrieve a campaign's execution status by UUID; returns { status: BaseTaskStatus } or ObservabilityError for 400/404/408/409/422.
Adds a beta observability endpoint to search chat completion events with filters, optional extra_fields, and cursor/page_size pagination; returns a feed of ChatCompletionEventPreview.

Adds POST /v1/observability/chat-completion-events/search-ids, an alternative to /search that returns only matching chat completion event IDs in bulk based on filter parameters; responds with ChatCompletionEventIds.

Introduces GET /v1/observability/chat-completion-events/{event_id} to fetch a ChatCompletionEvent by UUID, returning event details (messages, token counts, enabled tools, transcription events) on 200 or ObservabilityError on 400/404/408/409/422.

Adds POST /v1/observability/chat-completion-events/{event_id}/live-judging to run a judge on a specific chat completion event using the provided judge_definition; returns JudgeOutput with analysis and answer. Supports standard error responses (400, 404, 408, 409, 422).

Adds GET /v1/observability/chat-completion-events/{event_id}/similar-events to retrieve chat completion events similar to the specified event. Returns ChatCompletionEvents (FeedResult of ChatCompletionEventPreview). Possible errors: 400, 404, 408, 409, 422.
Adds GET /v1/observability/chat-completion-fields to return chat completion field metadata, including field_definitions and field_groups for observability.

Adds GET /v1/observability/chat-completion-fields/{field_name}/options to retrieve available filter options for a specified chat completion field using a required operator query parameter; returns an options array.

New beta endpoint to retrieve counts of distinct option values for a specified chat completion field. Accepts optional filter_params (FilterPayload) to scope events; responds with counts array of {value, count}.

Adds POST /v1/observability/dataset-records/bulk-delete to delete multiple dataset records by UUIDs (1–500). Accepts dataset_record_ids array; returns 204 on success with ObservabilityError on failures (400, 404, 408, 409, 422).
Introduces DELETE /v1/observability/dataset-records/{dataset_record_id} to delete a dataset record by ID. Returns 204 on success; error responses (400, 404, 408, 409, 422) include ObservabilityError.
Adds GET /v1/observability/dataset-records/{dataset_record_id} to retrieve a conversation DatasetRecord by UUID, returning its payload/messages and metadata.

Adds POST /v1/observability/dataset-records/{dataset_record_id}/live-judging to run a judge on a specific dataset record using a provided judge_definition; returns JudgeOutput (analysis and answer) with standard error responses.

Adds PUT /v1/observability/dataset-records/{dataset_record_id}/payload to update a dataset record's conversation payload. Accepts JSON body {"payload": {"messages": [...]}}; returns 204 on success, 400/404/408/409/422 on error.

Adds PUT /v1/observability/dataset-records/{dataset_record_id}/properties to update a dataset record's custom properties by UUID. Accepts JSON {properties: {...}} and returns 204 No Content on success; 400/404/408/409/422 return ObservabilityError.

New beta endpoint GET /v1/observability/datasets to list existing datasets. Supports pagination (page, page_size) and optional search (q); returns paginated DatasetPreview objects with count, next, previous, and results. Errors: 400, 404, 408, 409, 422.
Adds POST /v1/observability/datasets to create a new empty dataset from name and description; returns Dataset (201) or ObservabilityError on failures.
Introduces DELETE /v1/observability/datasets/{dataset_id} to delete a dataset by UUID. Returns 204 on success; possible errors: 400, 404, 408, 409, 422 with ObservabilityError body.
New endpoint GET /v1/observability/datasets/{dataset_id}/exports/to-jsonl exports a dataset to JSONL via the Files API and returns a presigned download URL.
Introduces GET /v1/observability/datasets/{dataset_id} to retrieve a dataset by UUID, returning a DatasetPreview with metadata; returns ObservabilityError for 4xx timeouts/conflicts/validation.
Adds an async endpoint to populate a dataset by importing records from a specified campaign. Accepts campaign_id in the JSON body and returns 202 with a DatasetImportTask to track progress.

Adds POST /v1/observability/datasets/{dataset_id}/imports/from-dataset to populate a dataset with samples from another dataset by providing dataset_record_ids (1–10,000); returns 202 with a DatasetImportTask.

Added POST /v1/observability/datasets/{dataset_id}/imports/from-explorer to populate a dataset with explorer samples using completion_event_ids; responds 202 with a DatasetImportTask to track the async import and standard error responses for 400, 404, 408, 409, 422.

Adds POST /v1/observability/datasets/{dataset_id}/imports/from-file to populate a dataset with samples from an uploaded file. Accepts JSON body {"file_id"}, responds 202 with DatasetImportTask (async). Error responses: 400, 404, 408, 409, 422.

Adds POST /v1/observability/datasets/{dataset_id}/imports/from-playground to import specified conversation_ids from the Playground into a dataset; returns 202 with a DatasetImportTask to track progress.
Introduces PATCH /v1/observability/datasets/{dataset_id} to partially update a dataset (name, description); returns DatasetPreview with updated metadata and standard error responses.

Introduces GET /v1/observability/datasets/{dataset_id}/records to list existing dataset records. Supports pagination via page and page_size; returns DatasetRecords with paginated DatasetRecord items. Error responses include 400, 404, 408, 409, and 422.

Adds POST /v1/observability/datasets/{dataset_id}/records to create a conversation record in a dataset. Accepts payload (ConversationPayload with messages[]) and properties (object). Returns 201 with the created DatasetRecord; errors include 400, 404, 408, 409, 422.
New GET endpoint to list import tasks for a dataset, supporting pagination via page and page_size.

Adds GET /v1/observability/datasets/{dataset_id}/tasks/{task_id} to retrieve the status and details of a dataset import task (DatasetImportTask). Returns task status, progress, message, and timestamps; error responses use ObservabilityError for 400/404/408/409/422.
Introduces GET /v1/observability/judges to list judge previews with optional type/model filters, search (q), and pagination; returns paginated JudgePreview results.
Adds POST /v1/observability/judges to create a new judge from PostJudgeInSchema and return a 201 JudgePreview.
Adds DELETE /v1/observability/judges/{judge_id} to delete a judge by UUID; 204 on success, standard error responses (400,404,408,409,422).
New GET /v1/observability/judges/{judge_id} to fetch a judge by UUID, returning JudgePreview on success or ObservabilityError on failure.

Adds POST /v1/observability/judges/{judge_id}/live-judging to run a saved judge on a provided conversation. Path param judge_id (UUID). Request body requires messages[] with optional properties; returns JudgeOutput with analysis and answer on success, or ObservabilityError on 400/404/408/409/422.
